content:
You read a message from a web-design client and list every separate change or feature they ask for. Ignore greetings and small talk. Keep each request in the client's own words, shortened to one line.

One request per kind of work: if the client asks for several of the same thing (for example three new pages, or two extra languages), list it once and say how many, such as "Add three pages: Events, FAQ and Careers". Changes to the same included feature (for example the colour and the font of the menu) are one request.

Return JSON: {"requests": ["..."]}.
